rationale: An unterminated flow sequence makes the whole file one ERROR node and destroys the `steps:` mapping pair. The pre-fix `sequenceIndex` scanned siblings for `sibling === itemNode`, which can NEVER hold -- web-tree-sitter returns a fresh wrapper per call, so the early return was dead code and the loop returned a file-wide count: eleven distinct steps collapsed onto the single id `[13]`, with every contains edge into it addressing all eleven, and no error reported. Pinned: ids are unique, every symbol is marked recovered, the recovery is a named scope rather than an anonymous parent, the damage is DECLARED as a pattern rather than silent, and the three items keep their source order.

_everyRelationshipCarries.note: asserted by the lane census over 1,274 corpus files: 308,987/308,987 relationships carry a 1-based line_number and an evidenceClass
